# lumos_apps (Data Source)

Apps in the organization, custom apps and connected integrations, optionally filtered.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Finds an app by name, for example to manage its App Store settings.
data "lumos_apps" "okta" {
  search = "Okta"
}

output "okta_app_id" {
  value = one([for app in data.lumos_apps.okta.apps : app.id if app.label == "Okta"])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `catalog_visibility` (String) Filter by the app's `appstore_settings.catalog_visibility` (`visible`, `search-only` or `hidden`). Pair it with `in_app_store=true` to list the AppStore by visibility; "Who Can Request" groups don't narrow this list. must be one of ["visible", "search-only", "hidden"]
- `connection_source` (String) Filter to integrations connected via this source (`api` or `ui`). must be one of ["api", "ui"]
- `disconnected` (Boolean) Filter on whether the app has been disconnected. `false` excludes disconnected apps, `true` returns only disconnected apps whose record Lumos still holds, and omitting it lists every app. Pair `false` with `connection_source=api` to list only the connected apps you manage through the API.
- `in_app_store` (Boolean) Filter by AppStore membership. `true` returns only apps in the AppStore; `false` returns only apps not in the AppStore; omit for all apps.
- `search` (String) Case-insensitive substring match against the app's label, instance identifier, and app class ID. Resend it with each `page_token`.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) Apps returned in this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `app_class_id` (String) The catalog identifier of the underlying app (e.g. "github.com"). Custom apps return "custom".
- `approval_workflow` (Attributes) The approval workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=approval_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to approval workflow templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--approval_workflow))
- `appstore_settings` (Attributes) AppStore membership and settings. Present when the caller has read access to AppStore items. Returns {in_app_store} by default; expand with expand=appstore_settings for the full settings object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings))
- `category` (String) The category this app belongs to.
- `custom_attributes` (Attributes Map) Custom attributes configured on this app, keyed by the attribute's name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--custom_attributes))
- `default_deprovisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The default deprovisioning workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=default_deprovisioning_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to AppStore item workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--default_deprovisioning_workflow))
- `default_provisioning_workflow` (Attributes) The default provisioning workflow for this app. Returns {id} by default; expand with expand=default_provisioning_workflow for the full workflow object. Omitted entirely if the caller lacks read access to AppStore item workflows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--default_provisioning_workflow))
- `description` (String) A description of the app.
- `disconnected` (Boolean) Whether this app has been disconnected (its stored credentials removed via `POST /v1/apps/{app_uuid}:disconnect`). A disconnected app is excluded from `GET /v1/apps?disconnected=false`; reconnect it by sending credentials to `PATCH /v1/apps/{app_uuid}`.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the app.
- `instance_id` (String) The app-instance identifier distinguishing multiple instances of the same app.
- `label` (String) The display name of the app.
- `logo_url` (String) URL of the app logo image.
- `post_approval_message` (String) Custom message shown to the requester after their access request is approved.
- `status` (String) The lifecycle status of this app. One of `discovered`, `in-review`, `needs-review`, `approved`, `blocklisted`, `deprecated`.
- `sync_status` (String) The state of this app's most recent sync: `syncing` while one is running, `success` or `failed` once it finished. Omitted when no sync result is recorded — the app has never synced, or was disconnected.
- `website_url` (String) URL of the app's official website.

<a id="nestedatt--apps--approval_workflow"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.approval_workflow`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the bound workflow.


<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings`

Read-Only:

- `allow_multiple_permission_selection` (Boolean) When true, requesters may select more than one permission in a single request.
- `allow_permission_selection` (Boolean) When true, requesters may select which permission to request. When false, the default permission is used automatically and only approvers can change it. An app that was never configured reports the value Lumos applies when validating its access requests, which may be false.
- `allowed_requester_group_uuids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the groups whose members may request this app. Null means the app is requestable by everyone in the tenant.
- `catalog_visibility` (String) Visibility of the app within the catalog. "visible" — shown in browse and search; "search-only" — returned only by search, not in browse; "hidden" — enrolled but not visible to requesters.
- `custom_intake_fields` (Attributes List) Custom form questions shown to requesters before they submit an access request. Null means no custom fields are configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--custom_intake_fields))
- `default_entitlement` (Attributes) The entitlement pre-selected by default when a user opens the request form. Null means no default is set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--default_entitlement))
- `in_app_store` (Boolean) Whether this app is listed in the AppStore catalog.
- `redirect_url` (String) If set, requesting this app redirects the user to this URL instead of going through the normal access-request flow. Null means no redirect is configured. Max 2048 characters.
- `request_instructions` (String) Custom instructions shown to a requester when they open the access-request form. Null means no custom instructions are set.
- `request_validation_webhook_uuid` (String) UUID of the inline webhook called to validate access requests before approval. Null means no validation webhook is configured.
- `time_based_access` (Attributes) Time-based access configuration for this app. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--time_based_access))

<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--custom_intake_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.custom_intake_fields`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Additional guidance shown alongside the prompt.
- `dropdown_options` (List of String) Selectable options for this field. Present only when field_type is "dropdown".
- `field_type` (String)
- `is_required` (Boolean) Whether the requester must answer this field to submit a request.
- `prompt` (String) The question shown to the requester.
- `reference_key` (String) Stable identifier for this field. It is unique within the app and cannot be changed.


<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--default_entitlement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.default_entitlement`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The UUID of the entitlement.


<a id="nestedatt--apps--appstore_settings--time_based_access"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.appstore_settings.time_based_access`

Read-Only:

- `default` (String) Label of the option pre-selected when a user opens the request form. Null means no option is pre-selected.
- `options` (List of String) Labels of the time-based access options offered for this app. An empty list means the app uses the domain-level defaults.
